import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int x;

        ModInt() { x = 0; }
        ModInt(int sig) {
            int sigt = sig % MOD;
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        ModInt(long sig) {
            int sigt = (int)(sig % MOD);
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        int get() { return x; }

        ModInt add(ModInt that) {
            int res = x + that.x;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        ModInt sub(ModInt that) {
            int res = x + MOD - that.x;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }
        ModInt mul(ModInt that) {
            long res = (long)x * that.x % MOD;
            return new ModInt((int)res);
        }

        void addAssign(ModInt that) {
            x += that.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
        }
        void subAssign(ModInt that) {
            x += MOD - that.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
        }
        void mulAssign(ModInt that) {
            x = (int)((long)x * that.x % MOD);
        }
    }

    static class FlatMatrix {
        int n, m;
        ModInt[][] data;

        FlatMatrix() {}
        FlatMatrix(int n_, int m_) {
            n = n_;
            m = m_;
            data = new ModInt[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    data[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
        }

        int height() { return n; }
        int width() { return m; }

        ModInt get(int i, int j) { return data[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, ModInt val) { data[i][j] = val; }

        static FlatMatrix identity(int n) {
            FlatMatrix A = new FlatMatrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                A.data[i][i] = new ModInt(1);
            return A;
        }

        static FlatMatrix identity(FlatMatrix A) { return identity(A.height()); }

        void multiplyAssign(FlatMatrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = B.height();
            if (p != width()) throw new AssertionError("Dimension mismatch");
            FlatMatrix w = new FlatMatrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    ModInt x = new ModInt(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        x.addAssign(get(i, k).mul(B.get(k, j)));
                    }
                    w.set(i, j, x);
                }
            }
            this.n = w.n;
            this.m = w.m;
            this.data = w.data;
        }

        static FlatMatrix multiply(FlatMatrix A, FlatMatrix B) {
            FlatMatrix C = new FlatMatrix(A.n, B.m);
            for (int i = 0; i < A.n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < B.m; j++) {
                    ModInt x = new ModInt(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < A.m; k++) {
                        x.addAssign(A.get(i, k).mul(B.get(k, j)));
                    }
                    C.set(i, j, x);
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        static FlatMatrix pow(FlatMatrix A, long k) {
            FlatMatrix result = identity(A);
            FlatMatrix base = A;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) != 0) {
                    result = multiply(result, base);
                }
                base = multiply(base, base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static FlatMatrix getRotateMatrixFlat(int k, int t) {
        t = (t % k + k) % k;
        FlatMatrix A = new FlatMatrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            A.set(i, (i + t) % k, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k, k, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new ModInt(1));
        return A;
    }

    static FlatMatrix getSingletonMatrixFlat(int k, int j) {
        FlatMatrix A = new FlatMatrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j)
                A.set(i, i, new ModInt(1));
        }
        A.set(k+1, k+1, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(k+2, k+2, new ModInt(1));

        A.set(k, k+1, new ModInt(1));
        A.set(j, k+1, new ModInt(-1));

        A.set(k, k, new ModInt(2));
        A.set(j, k, new ModInt(-1));

        A.set(k, j, new ModInt(1));
        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();

            FlatMatrix b = new FlatMatrix(1, k + 3);
            b.set(0, k, new ModInt(1));
            b.set(0, k+1, new ModInt(1));
            b.set(0, k+2, new ModInt(1));

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                digits++;
            }

            FlatMatrix[] P = new FlatMatrix[digits + 1];
            P[0] = getSingletonMatrixFlat(k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                P[i] = FlatMatrix.identity(k + 3);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    P[i] = FlatMatrix.multiply(P[i], P[i-1]);
                    P[i] = FlatMatrix.multiply(P[i], getRotateMatrixFlat(k, -1));
                }
            }

            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    b = FlatMatrix.multiply(b, getRotateMatrixFlat(k, -s));
                    b = FlatMatrix.multiply(b, P[digits]);
                    b = FlatMatrix.multiply(b, getRotateMatrixFlat(k, +s));
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                digits--;
            }

            ModInt ans = b.get(0, k+1);
            System.out.println(ans.get());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
